assertions: A second ResearchService instance continues a cursor from MySQL with identical snapshotAt, rows and source reason.
Changing q rejects the cursor; a snapshot older than 120 seconds is deleted and rejects continuation.
Concurrent continuation returns the same page and creation cleanup retains at most 32 snapshots.
The local HTTP endpoint returns q=JCT with completeness=complete, total=1 and missing source measurements as null.
limitations: This does not prove database crash recovery, backup restore, source usage rights, complete provider coverage or production availability.
